The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1890–1891''' was contested by five teams from the cities [[Amsterdam]], [[The Hague]], [[Haarlem]] and [[Rotterdam]]. The teams participated in the competition that would later be called ''Eerste Klasse West''. But since the western football district of the Netherlands was the only one to have a competition at the time, it could be regarded as a national championship, making it the first proper football league in Continental Europe. [[HVV Den Haag]] from [[The Hague]] won the championship, it was considered to be the first official one, since it was the first season in which all teams played an equal number of matches.
